# ZERO bare if/else/else_if in scripted_triggers (EU5 1.4.9 G06 hard rule).

# Country scope. Eligible industrializing host (1740-1836): any human player with >= 3 locations,
# or any independent Great Power / major realm (>= 30 locations) capable of industrializing.
oe_stm_eligible_industrial_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		AND = {
			is_ai = no
			num_locations >= 3
		}
		AND = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_subject = no
			OR = {
				is_great_power = yes
				num_locations >= 30
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible settled Nova Elysia host for Act III (1600-1836), reusing oe_el2_is_settled_elysia.
oe_stm_eligible_elysia_act3_host = {
	AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia }
	num_locations >= 5
}
